nodes.notes: true = no duplicate found → proceed. false = duplicate → log and discard.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO dedupe_log (business_name, phone_raw, country, source, reason) VALUES ('{{ $json.business_name }}', '{{ $json.phone_raw }}', '{{ $json.country }}', '{{ $json.source }}', 'phone_match')

INSERT INTO leads (business_name, category, phone_raw, phone_normalized, address, website, has_website, rating, review_count, source, region, country, preferred_language, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.business_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.category }}',
  '{{ $json.phone_raw }}',
  '{{ $json.phone_normalized }}',
  '{{ ($json.address || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.website ? "'" + $json.website + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.website ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  {{ $json.rating ?? 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.review_count ?? 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.region }}',
  '{{ $json.country }}',
  {{ $json.country === 'IN' ? "'hinglish'" : "'english'" }},
  'pending_approval'
)
RETURNING id

nodes.name: Groq: Pain-Point Detection
nodes.notes: Uses Groq free tier — llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Add GROQ_API_KEY to n8n env vars. Free: 14,400 calls/day.

nodes.name: Parse WA Draft + Build Deep Link

parameters.query:
UPDATE leads SET
  pain_point = '{{ $json.pain_point.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  angle = '{{ $json.angle.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  confidence = '{{ $json.confidence }}',
  whatsapp_draft = '{{ $json.whatsapp_draft.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  whatsapp_deep_link = '{{ $json.whatsapp_deep_link }}',
  status = 'pending_approval',
  enriched_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.lead_id }}'

nodes.name: Update Lead: AI Outputs + Status
nodes.notes: Writes pain_point, angle, confidence, whatsapp_draft, deep_link, and sets status=pending_approval.
